note: Per-question calibration for setup/laya/server.py, fitted on the even-indexed cases of Reflex's golden sets (tool gate golden-v5, injection-golden-v3, instructions, routing) and scored on the odd ones. Yes/no questions: Platt scaling {a, b} of the logit (a >= 0, so the ranking is never inverted; a = 0 means Laya showed no usable signal and the answer is the base rate). Choice and score: one temperature. Labels: the answers Jev 1.13.0 gave in the same evaluation run for the tool gate and the guard, the golden labels for instructions and routing. `f` is every instruction fragment. Refit with docs/GUIDE.md#laya when the questions, the checkpoints or the golden sets change.
